messages:
Anika: Quick async triage check — yesterday I closed 18 tickets, queue at 63 right now (up +12 vs yesterday). High-priority: intermittent duplicate payment webhook retries. I've pushed a macro update for billing escalations and a temporary note for agents.

Chris: Can you drop the macro text here? Want to confirm we don't accidentally auto-ack failures. :eyes:

Anika: Paste below — it's just a canned escalation + investigation steps. Agents should add payment IDs before sending.
```
Subject: Billing webhook duplicate payments — escalate to engineering
Body: Please include: customer_id, payment_id, webhook_timestamp, and attach the webhook payload. Do not refund until eng confirms. Tag @eng-oncall.
```

Deploy Bot: Deployment billing-fix-2026.03.17 to production succeeded (no rollback).

Maya: Oncall handoff at 16:00 PT — I can take webhook escalations after 16:30. If infra needs a config flip earlier ping me. :thumbsup:

Sam: FYI, embeddings had a latency spike in eu-west between 02:10-02:25 UTC — ~9 failed embedding requests that retried and resolved. Might be related to model cache churn. Not high severity but flagged in Support queue.

Lee: I opened CR #4321 to tighten webhook retry backoff and added telemetry for duplicate detection. @Chris can you review when you have a minute? It's small but needs a quick stamp.

Chris: Pinging on CR #4321 now. I can review after standup (ETA ~30m). If infra wants to toggle retry throttle earlier, we should coordinate.

Anika: Blockers: waiting on infra to approve increasing webhook worker pool or enabling retry-throttle patch. If no decision by 13:00 UTC deploy emergency config (we have runbook). Also need one more review on the CR to land the duplicate-detect change.

Infra Bot: Infra request #9812 updated — webhook autoscale + retry-throttle flagged for ops approval. ETA for manual review: 11:45 UTC.

Maya: Quick note for agents — updated macros include a checklist: 1) capture payment_id, 2) check webhooks dashboard (link), 3) escalate if >1 duplicate. Saved as `billing/duplicate_webhook_v2`.

Chris: I'll aim to review CR before 12:30 UTC. If I can't, Sam can do a perf sanity check.

Anika: TL;DR: queue up (63), billing webhook duplicates prioritized, macro updated, CR #4321 awaiting review, infra approval pending, oncall handoff at 16:00 PT. If you pick up escalations mark with `@support-escalate` so we don't duplicate work.

Lee: Noted — I'll add a quick alert to the dashboard to show duplicate-payment rate over last 2h.

Maya: Thanks team — will take ownership of open webhook escalations this afternoon. :coffee:
